title: Vectors: SOS network behavior test cases
description: Test vectors for priority routing and beacon boost
close_reason: Already covered / Not applicable: Priority routing is covered by tx_queue_priority.json (SOS P0 priority, preemption, strict ordering). Beacon boost (30s interval) is a timer-based behavior not suitable for test vectors - test vectors in this project are byte-level codec/format conformance tests. Timer behaviors should be tested in integration/unit tests.
